hooks.name: Update producer steering when MCP tools change
hooks.description: Keeps the producer-agent steering file's tool list matching the MCP server.

action.prompt: backend/mcp_server.py was just saved. Check that the Tools list and workflow in .kiro/steering/producer-agent.md still match the @mcp.tool() functions (names, arguments, behavior). If they differ, update the steering file to match and say what changed.
